title: Banach Hardy-Sobolev Spaces on the Upper Half-plane and Operator Theory
summary: We study Hardy--Sobolev spaces H_n^p(C^+) on the upper half-plane for 1<=p<=infty and n is a nonnegative integer, from both function-theoretic and operator-theoretic viewpoints. We establish an isometric boundary characterization of H_n^p(C^+) via nontangential limits, together with a Sobolev-type embedding theorem, a Cauchy integral representation, a direct-sum decomposition of W_n^p(R) for 1<p<infty, and a generalized Banach algebra structure under pointwise multiplication.
